name: tab09
definition: 业务主记录 Counterexample: 与 tab11 为同族副本,不应另建对象;与 tab01/tab03 等含 fld009 的表区分,后者属另一表族线索 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab09; provenance: direct source tab09

name: tab11
definition: 业务主记录副本 Counterexample: 与 tab09 同族,不应作为独立业务概念;其独有列 fld037/fld038/fld039/fld040 需人工确认是否扩展属性 Maturity: Provisional

name: tab01
definition: 业务明细记录 Counterexample: 与 tab09 表族不同,不可合并;与 tab02 共享 fld003/fld009 但列集不同,需按关系而非同族处理 Maturity: Provisional

name: tab02
definition: 业务子记录 Counterexample: 与 tab01 共享部分列但列集不同,属不同对象;不可因共享 fld009 判为同族 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab02; provenance: direct source tab02

name: tab03
definition: 业务扩展记录 Counterexample: 与 tab09 共享 fld013 但列集差异大,不属同族;与 tab02 共享 fld012 需按关系验证 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab03; provenance: direct source tab03

name: tab04

scope: Records of table tab04; provenance: direct source tab04

name: tab05
definition: 业务汇总记录 Counterexample: 与 tab01 共享 fld001/fld003 但列集不同,不属同族;与 tab09 共享 fld021/fld024 需按关系验证 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab05; provenance: direct source tab05

name: tab06
definition: 业务配置记录 Counterexample: 与 tab07/tab08 共享三列但列集不同,不属同族;与 tab12 共享 fld027 需按关系验证 Maturity: Provisional

name: tab08

name: Driver
definition: A person who races in Formula 1

name: DriverForename
definition: Driver's first name

name: DriverSurname
definition: Driver's last name

name: DriverReferenceName
definition: Short reference code for a driver

name: DriverCode
definition: Three-letter driver abbreviation

name: DriverNationality
definition: Driver's country of nationality

name: DriverDateOfBirth
definition: Driver's date of birth

name: DriverNumber
definition: Driver's racing number

name: Constructor
definition: Formula 1 team/constructor

name: ConstructorReferenceName
definition: Short reference code for a constructor

name: ConstructorNationality
definition: Constructor's country

name: ConstructorWebsite
definition: Constructor's official website URL

name: Race
definition: A Formula 1 race event

name: RaceName
definition: Official name of the race

name: RaceYear
definition: Year the race was held

name: RaceDate
definition: Date the race was held

name: RaceRound
definition: Round number within the season

name: Circuit
definition: Racing circuit/track

name: CircuitName
definition: Official name of the circuit

name: CircuitReferenceName
definition: Short reference code for a circuit

name: CircuitCountry
definition: Country where the circuit is located

name: RaceResult
definition: A driver's result in a race

name: RacePosition
definition: Driver's finishing position in a race

name: RacePoints
definition: Points scored by a driver in a race

name: RaceLapTime
definition: Lap time recorded in a race

name: RaceLapNumber
definition: Number of laps completed

name: RaceCompletion
definition: Whether a driver completed the race (has a recorded time)
scope: tab09 where fld024 IS NOT NULL

name: QualifyingTime
definition: Time recorded in a qualifying session

name: FastestLapTime
definition: Fastest lap time recorded by a driver
scope: tab13 where fld048 IS NOT NULL

name: FastestLapRank
definition: Rank of the fastest lap

name: FastestLapNumber
definition: Lap number on which the fastest lap was set

name: PitStopDuration
definition: Duration of a pit stop

name: PitStopCount
definition: Count of pit stops

name: LapTimeRecord
definition: Individual lap time record

name: RaceCompletionRate
definition: Share of race entries where the driver completed the race Formula: RaceCompletion / RaceResult. Inputs: RaceCompletion = tab09.fld024 WHERE fld024 IS NOT NULL; RaceResult = tab11.fld037

name: WinCount
definition: Number of races won by a driver Formula: COUNT(RaceResult WHERE RacePosition = 1). Inputs: RaceResult = tab11.fld037; RacePosition = tab11.fld038

name: AverageLapTime
definition: Average lap time for a driver in a race Formula: AVG(RaceLapTime). Inputs: RaceLapTime = tab09.fld034

name: TotalPoints
definition: Sum of points scored Formula: SUM(RacePoints). Inputs: RacePoints = tab11.fld039

name: GermanRacePercentage
definition: Share of European Grand Prix races hosted in Germany Formula: COUNT(Race WHERE CircuitCountry='Germany') / COUNT(Race). Inputs: Race = tab05.fld021; CircuitCountry = tab01.fld004
aliases: percentage of races hosted in Germany

name: YoungestDriverAge
definition: Driver age derived from date of birth Formula: MAX(DriverDateOfBirth) for youngest, MIN for oldest. Inputs: DriverDateOfBirth = tab03.fld019

name: FastestLapCount
definition: Number of fastest laps set by a driver Formula: COUNT(FastestLapTime). Inputs: FastestLapTime = tab13.fld048 WHERE fld048 IS NOT NULL

name: LapCompletionRate
definition: Share of laps completed relative to total Formula: RaceLapNumber / MAX(RaceLapNumber). Inputs: RaceLapNumber = tab09.fld033

name: PodiumRate
definition: Share of races finishing in top 3 Formula: COUNT(RaceResult WHERE RacePosition <= 3) / RaceResult. Inputs: RaceResult = tab11.fld037; RacePosition = tab11.fld038

name: DriverNationality
definition: Driver nationality codes used to filter drivers by country

name: ConstructorNationality
definition: Constructor nationality codes
